video_title: Jalen & Josh React to Viral Moments of the Week

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart explains why he didn't bring his daughter on his lap
quotes.excerpt: Game is still going on. Can't pull a Josh. I can't tell Josh what to do and then do it.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Hillman
text_blocks.text: You were like looking back at her but also trying not to look too unfocused and also look at the game. Were you like, damn, let me not, I don't want to say let me not be like Josh, but you know, when Josh was, you were like, let me not.

text_blocks.speaker: Josh Hart
text_blocks.text: I mean, let me just stay focused and let me just look at her real quick and then like back. Still stay focused, yeah.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Hillman
text_blocks.text: So you didn't want to bring her onto your lap?

text_blocks.speaker: Josh Hart
text_blocks.text: No, no, no. Game is still going on. Can't pull a Josh. I can't tell Josh what to do and then do it.

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: I mean, at that point we were probably up like 35 with like four minutes left. I'm like, hey brother, grab me if you want a kid.

text_blocks.speaker: Josh Hart
text_blocks.text: Yeah, but I'm just saying, what type of person am I to tell your Josh like, probably shouldn't do that, and then go ahead and do that.

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: I think it depends on the, I think it depends on the situations.

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: Now it's like, Josh, we're up 13 with two minutes left. And then you go, little touch and go. You know what I mean?

text_blocks.speaker: Josh Hart
text_blocks.text: But then if I do that, if I do that, then the memes come out, oh, Knicks beat Sixers, and then they're playing with their kids on the bench. I don't even want that. Because there's going to be someone to do something like that.

text_blocks.speaker: Josh Hart
text_blocks.text: Yeah, you're right. I just don't, I just don't even give them an opportunity. That's my thing.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson blames JR Smith for being in the crowd
quotes.excerpt: JR, that's your fault. You were wrong because you knew what they were about to do when you got out there.
quotes.quote: No, JR Smith, I'll say this, he had no business being in that street. He played in New York. He knows how New York fans are. And then he went out there knowing it was about to get rowdy and then he got mad at them. So that was his fault. I said it wholeheartedly. JR, that's your fault. You were wrong because you knew what they were about to do when you got out there. But that being said, it'll be lit to go out there because now you already know what it's going to be. Now it's like, you go out there, you just got to rage with them. So, that'd be good vibes.
